== Summary ==
Partial slip “•Failure At The Cave” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 300 dpi. Version [[Failure At The Cave (V) (Errata)#Source formats|Failure At The Cave (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Not a recreation.
